title: Collections: map, filter, fold, and the sequence that is lazy

videos.script: A week of study sessions. The total per course. The longest one. Whether any ran past ninety minutes. Each of those is a loop, and this lesson replaces nearly every one of them with a word. {{lists}} It starts with two kinds of list. One you can read, and one you can change, and the compiler knows which is which. {{mapfilter}} Then the two things you do most: keep some items, and turn each item into something else. {{aggregates}} The questions with one answer: sum, count, any, the largest. And the ones that throw on an empty list. {{grouping}} Grouping by course, which is the planner's weekly screen in one line. {{fold}} Fold, the loop with nothing decided, for the questions no function has a name for. {{lazy}} And the sequence. Same answers, different order of work, and the order is the whole point. {{maps}} Maps and sets close it.
